title: feuilleea carnosa
intro: Feuilleea carnosa, commonly known as Dwarf Flossflower, is a type of flowering plant in the daisy family that is native to Asia. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Feuilleea carnosa has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its therapeutic actions, including anti-cough and expectorant properties, to relieve respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
